newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish FIH issues variable 600 mln Dkk bond.
newsitem.headline: Danish FIH issues variable 600 mln Dkk bond.

text.p: Denmark's Unidanmark bank said on Monday it arranged a 600 million crown bond at variable rates for Danish finance institute FIH.

Lead manager Unidanmark said the bonds would be listed at the Copenhagen Stock Exchange on November 15, with coupon rates between a maximum 4.25 percent and 7.25 percent, with the maturity date set for December 20, 2000.
It said the coupon would be set two days before pay dates at CIBOR plus 0.40 percentage point.
Pay dates were set for the third Wednesday in the months of December, March, June and September, it said.
